input.summary: V05 Nilagiri Phytolabs LLP (Prakash). Quote received for RFx KPC-2026-014: Glycerin 118/kg; Rosemary extract 20% 7000/kg, MOQ 100 kg, 12-month shelf life; Caffeine 1650/kg only if one full lot (size unstated). Freight extra ~Rs 9/kg. Terms: 50% advance, 49% on delivery; 3-week delivery. Claims 99% OTIF and zero rejection (no data). Certificates under renewal; offers COA only after order, which conflicts with our need for COA before award. Open: RM-002 MOQ and shelf life; RM-005 MOQ in kg and shelf life; knockouts H1 (SDS), B5 (COA), H2 (cosmetic suitability) pending. Clarification email sent earlier; no reply by the 14 Nov 2026 deadline (no_reply event). Sending a short firm reminder covering open items.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: Reminder, response still required
input.body:
Dear Prakash,

We have not yet received your reply to our clarification request for RFx KPC-2026-014, and the response deadline of 14 November 2026 has passed. Please reply by return with the following. Items 1 to 4 and 7 to 9 are required before we can take your quote further.

Quote clarifications:
1. Glycerin (RM-002): state the minimum order quantity in kg and the order multiple.
2. Glycerin (RM-002): state the total shelf life from date of manufacture, and the minimum remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.
3. Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005): state the lot size in kg that "one full lot" refers to.
4. Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005): state the total shelf life from date of manufacture, and the minimum remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.
5. Need-by date: can you deliver the first lot by 20 December 2026? If not, state your earliest date.

Compliance and quality documents (required for Glycerin, Rosemary leaf extract and Caffeine anhydrous):
6. Current Safety Data Sheet for each line, including transport hazard class.
7. Certificate of Analysis from a recent batch for each line, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date. Our requirement is a COA before award, not after order.
8. Confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp cosmetic use and permitted under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Delivery:
9. Your on-time-in-full (OTIF) rate for these lines over the last 12 months, with your definition of on-time.

If you cannot provide any item, state so explicitly and give the reason. We will review what we receive and come back to you.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
